arxiv-2011-05878.title: Kings in Multipartite Hypertournaments
arxiv-2011-05878.creator: Jiangdong Ai, Stefanie Gerke, Gregory Gutin
arxiv-2011-05878.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jiangdong Ai, Stefanie Gerke, Gregory Gutin. In his paper “Kings in Bipartite Hypertournaments” (Graphs & \& Combinatorics 35, 2019), Petrovic stated two conjectures on 4-kings in multipartite hypertournaments. We prove one of these conjectures and give counterexamples for the other.

arxiv-2012-02348.title: Analog particle production model for general classes of Taub-NUT black holes
arxiv-2012-02348.creator: Joshua Foo 1, Michael R.R. Good 2, Robert B. Mann 3,4
arxiv-2012-02348.description: Abstract We derive a correspondence between the Hawking radiation spectra emitted from general classes of Taub-NUT black holes with that induced by the relativistic motion of an accelerated Dirichlet boundary condition (i.e. a perfectly reflecting mirror) in (1+1)-dimensional flat spacetime.

arxiv-2102-01116.title: Diagnosis of Acute Poisoning Using Explainable Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2102-01116.creator: Michael Chary, MD PhD 1,3∗ , Ed W Boyer, MD PhD 2 , Michele Burns, MD, MS 3
arxiv-2102-01116.description: Abstract Medical toxicology is the clinical specialty that treats the toxic effects of substances, for example, an overdose, a medication error, or a scorpion sting. The volume of toxicological knowledge and research has, as with other medical specialties, outstripped the ability of the individual clinician to entirely master and stay current with it.

arxiv-2205-13331.title: TransBoost: Improving the Best ImageNet Performance using Deep Transduction
arxiv-2205-13331.creator: Omer BelhasinDepartment of Computer ScienceTechnion - Israel Institute of Technology omer.be@cs.technion.ac.il, Guy Bar-ShalomDepartment of Computer ScienceTechnion - Israel Institute of Technology guy.b@cs.technion.ac.il Ran El-YanivDepartment of Computer ScienceTechnion - Israel Institute of Techn
arxiv-2205-13331.description: Abstract This paper deals with deep transductive learning , and proposes TransBoost as a procedure for fine-tuning any deep neural model to improve its performance on any (unlabeled) test set provided at training time. TransBoost is inspired by a large margin principle and is efficient and simple to use.

arxiv-2309-11974.title: Real quadratic singular moduli and p p -adic families of modular forms
arxiv-2309-11974.creator: Paulina Fust, Judith Ludwig, Alice Pozzi, Mafalda Santos, Hanneke Wiersema
arxiv-2309-11974.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Paulina Fust, Judith Ludwig, Alice Pozzi, Mafalda Santos, Hanneke Wiersema. The classical theory of elliptic curves with complex multiplication is a fundamental tool for studying the arithmetic of abelian extensions of imaginary quadratic fields. While no direct analogue is available for real quadratic fields, a (conjectural) theory of “real multiplication” was recently proposed by Darmon and Vonk, relying on p p -adic methods, and in particular on the new notion of rigid meromorphic cocycles.

arxiv-2311-02854.title: A distributed multi-GPU ab initio density matrix renormalization group algorithm with applications to the P-cluster of nitrogenase
arxiv-2311-02854.creator: Chunyang Xiang, Weile Jia, Wei-Hai Fang, Zhendong Li
arxiv-2311-02854.description: Abstract The presence of many degenerate d / f d/f orbitals makes polynuclear transition metal compounds such as iron-sulfur clusters in nitrogenase challenging for state-of-the-art quantum chemistry methods. To address this challenge, we present the first distributed multi-GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) ab initio density matrix renormalization (DMRG) algorithm, suitable for modern high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructures.

arxiv-2402-11116.title: Thermodynamically consistent Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations using the metriplectic dynamics formalism
arxiv-2402-11116.creator: Azeddine Zaidni, Philip J Morrison, Saad Benjelloun
arxiv-2402-11116.description: Abstract Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes (CHNS) systems describes flows with two-phases, e.g., a liquid with bubbles. Obtaining constitutive relations for general dissipative processes for such a systems, which are thermodynamically consistent, can be a challenge. We show how the metriplectic 4-bracket formalism [ 30 ] achieves this in a straightforward, in fact algorithmic, manner.

arxiv-2406-15390.title: Cosmological test of an ultraviolet origin of Dark Energy
arxiv-2406-15390.creator: Hans Christiansen, Bence Takács, Steen H. Hansen ‡*
arxiv-2406-15390.description: Abstract The accelerated expansion of the Universe is impressively well described by a cosmological constant. However, the observed value of the cosmological constant is much smaller than expected based on quantum field theories. Recent efforts to achieve consistency in these theories have proposed a relationship between Dark Energy and the most compact objects, such as black holes (BH).

arxiv-2410-23145.title: Statistical Mechanics of Multiplectoneme Phases in DNA
arxiv-2410-23145.creator: Midas Segers, Enrico Skoruppa, Helmut Schiessel, Enrico Carlon
arxiv-2410-23145.description: Abstract A stretched DNA molecule which is also under- or overwound, undergoes a buckling transition forming intertwined looped domains called plectonemes. Here we develop a simple theory that extends the two-phase model of stretched supercoiled DNA, allowing for the coexistence of multiple plectonemic domains by including positional and length distribution entropies.

arxiv-2512-14467.title: Ensemble Parameter Estimation for the LPLSP Framework: A Rapid Approach to Reduced-Order Modeling for Transient Thermal Systems
arxiv-2512-14467.creator: Neelakantan Padmanabhan
arxiv-2512-14467.description: Abstract \keepXColumns \keepXColumns 1 Abstract This work introduces an ensemble parameter estimation framework that enables the Lumped Parameter Linear Superposition (LPLSP) method to generate reduced order thermal models from a single transient dataset. Unlike earlier implementations that relied on multiple parametric simulations to excite each heat source independently, the proposed approach simultaneously identifies all model coefficients using fully transient excitations.

arxiv-2602-14416.title: Near-Threshold J/ ψ \psi → μ + ​ μ − \to\mu^{+}\mu^{-} Photoproduction and the Gluonic Gravitational Form Factors of the Proton
arxiv-2602-14416.creator: S. Joosten, Z.-E. Meziani, S. Prasad, J. Swartz, B. Duran, M. K. Jones, H. Klest, M. Paolone, C. Peng, W. Armstrong, H. Atac, E. Chudakov, H. Bhatt, D. Bhetuwal, M. Boer, A. Camsonne, J.-P. Chen, M. Dalton, N. Deokar, M. Diefenthaler, J. Dunne, L. El Fassi, F. Flor, E. Fuchey, H. Gao, D. Gaskell, O.
arxiv-2602-14416.description: Abstract We report on the measurement of the two-dimensional differential cross section for near-threshold J/ ψ \psi → μ + ​ μ − \to\mu^{+}\mu^{-} photoproduction from the J/ ψ \psi –007 experiment in Hall C at Jefferson Lab. Our results agree with the previously published J/ ψ \psi → e + ​ e − \to e^{+}e^{-} results.

pmc-10506791.title: Dental anomalies in individuals with osteogenesis imperfecta: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prevalence and comparative studies
pmc-10506791.creator: Heloisa Vieira PRADO, Enio Cássio Barreto SOARES, Natália Cristina Ruy CARNEIRO, Ivanete Cláudia de Oliveira VILAR, Lucas Guimarães ABREU, Ana Cristina BORGES-OLIVEIRA
pmc-10506791.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background Osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) is a rare genetic disorder primarily caused by mutations in the genes involved in the production of type 1 collagen. OI is also known as brittle bone disease.Objective This study aims to describe the prevalence of dental anomalies (except dentinogenesis imperfecta) in individuals with OI, and compare the prevalence of dental anomalies between individuals with and without OI and between individuals with different types of OI.Search methods Searches in PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Ovid, and gray literature
